item.title: [6] Directly probing the carrier transfer length in 2D-material transistors
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Lain-Jong Li, Ya-Ping Chiu

Authors: Zi-Liang Yang, Bo-Chao Huang, Yu-Kuan Lin, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: STM study of 2D material contacts, potentially relevant to experimental techniques.

Tags: #STM #2Dmaterials #electronicstructure

Abstract: Cross-sectional scanning tunnelling microscopy shows a 2 nm carrier transfer length in bismuth-contacted monolayer MoS2 transistors, defining metal-contact scaling limits for sub-10 nm 2D electronic devices.
